newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NSA drops as undbundling deadline passes.
newsitem.headline: NSA drops as undbundling deadline passes.

text.p: Shares in South African holding firm NSA Investments Ltd dropped on Monday as the deadline to register for the firm's partial unbundling passed at the end of last week, dealers said.
The stock fell 145 cents to 13.00 rand by 1005 GMT.
"It is just the unbundling deadline passing. It will always take a bit of value out of a stock," one dealer said.
NSA said in February that it would unbundle its holdings in Education Investment Corp Ltd (Educor) and Housewares Group Ltd in a move worth about 200 million rand.
NSA currently holds about ten percent of Educor and 16 percent of Housewares.
NSA said the unbundling would have a value of about 1.50 rand per NSA ordinary share on a fully diluted basis.
